versions.content: Available space of user data without PncBitVector If Nm- Cluster . nmPncParticipation is set to false (i.e. no partial network is enabled on that NmCluster ) then user data may be defined in the range between the NM system bytes (CBV, Nid) and the end of the NmPdu . The size of user data range is determined by the difference between NmPdu . length and the length of the system bytes (Nid, CBV).
